correctness.rationale: PASS. Explicit triangle kernels give J^m+(-1)^(m-1)(J*)^m=P_m, polynomial kernel (x-t)^(m-1)/(m-1)!, rank exactly m by independent Hilbert-matrix moments, and infinite rank for every other coefficient. Periodic inverse-derivative B_m has two-fold singular values (2πj)^(-m), and J^m-B_m has polynomial range dimension at most m+1, so finite-rank singular-value interlacing yields lim (πn)^m s_n=|1-(-1)^(m-1)λ| for fixed λ≠critical; Schatten S_p iff p>1/m. Anti-diagonal moment coefficient C and positive Hilbert Gram matrix H give the claimed odd self-adjoint inertia/even skew inertia, determinant and HS norm. Independently formed exact C,H for m=1..8, verified full rank, transpose parity, zero trace for m>=2 and exact asserted determinant products. These finite checks do not prove the all-order asymptotic; interlacing does.
